title: Time and space generalized diffusion equation on graphs/networks
one_liner_zh: 该文提出图上的时间-空间广义扩散方程，模拟蛋白质沿DNA链的亚扩散-超扩散交替机制，虽非直接TF-DNA结合建模，但为蛋白-DNA动态互作机理提供可迁移的物理模拟方法。
abstract: Normal and anomalous diffusion are ubiquitous in many complex systems [1] . Here, we define a time and space generalized diffusion equation (GDE), which uses fractional-time derivatives and transformed d-path Laplacian operators on graphs/networks. We find analytically the solution of this equation and prove that it covers the regimes of normal, sub- and superdiffusion as a function of the two parameters of the model. We extend the GDE to consider a system with temporal alternancy of normal and anomalous diffusion which can be observed for instance in the diffusion of proteins along a DNA chain. We perform computational experiments on a one-dimensional system emulating a linear DNA chain. It is shown that a subdiffusive-superdiffusive alternant regime allows the diffusive particle to explore more slowly small regions of the chain with a faster global exploration, than a subdiffusive-subdiffusive regime. Therefore, an alternancy of sliding (subdiffusive) with hopping and intersegmental transfer (superdiffusive) mechanisms show important advances for protein-DNA interactions.
abstract_zh: 正常与反常扩散在许多复杂系统中普遍存在[1]。在此，我们定义了一个时间和空间广义扩散方程（GDE），该方程在图形/网络上使用分数阶时间导数和变换的d路径拉普拉斯算子。我们解析地找到了该方程的解，并证明它涵盖了正常、次扩散和超扩散的机制，这取决于模型的两个参数。我们将GDE扩展以考虑具有正常与反常扩散时间交替的系统，这种交替现象例如可以在蛋白质沿DNA链扩散中观察到。我们在模拟线性DNA链的一维系统上进行了计算实验。结果表明，次扩散-超扩散交替机制允许扩散粒子以更慢的速度探索链的小区域，但整体探索速度更快，相比次扩散-次扩散机制。因此，滑动（次扩散）与跳跃及段间转移（超扩散）机制的交替对蛋白质-DNA相互作用显示出重要进展。
